title: RN 0.85 upgrade breaks the CI test job
symptom: Tests that passed on the prior RN suddenly fail to run in CI after the RN 0.85 (2026-04-07) upgrade; or a build fails referencing StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject; or npm install fails on the CI image.
expected_root_cause: RN 0.85 extracted the Jest preset into @react-native/jest-preset (a silent CI breakage — the preset just isn't there anymore); StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject was removed (use absoluteFill); RN 0.84 bumped min Node to 22 (older CI images fail install; Node 21/23 unsupported on 0.85)
expected_fix: Install and configure @react-native/jest-preset separately and update the Jest config; migrate absoluteFillObject to absoluteFill; bump the CI Node image to >=22 and off 21/23
